notes: v0.16.8 upgrades Speed > Accuracy > Usage Saving across aesthetic planning and native macOS Computer Use. It fixes false UI detection from English happy/appearance, explicit avoid-list conflicts, whitespace duplicate reviewers, malformed artifact ids/refs; adds opt-in detail=compact (~34.2% fewer JSON bytes while retaining hard gates), and optimizes single-domain/no-avoid hot paths (three controlled 5000-case A/B seeds show 6-9% shorter in-process P50, not end-to-end). Native AX now reports omitted depth descendants and exact-capacity sentinel state, with actionable depth_budget/element_budget reasons. An optional observe-only cursor-drift flag (strict default, never valid for assertions or mutations) avoids failure when the user independently moves the pointer, retaining explicit cursor/focus metadata. Real Finder shallow/deep source probes and 7/7 complete fixed-depth read-only A/B; no global Computer Use speedup or user-art beauty claim. See docs/verification/2026-10-10-v0168-aesthetic-optimization.md.
